---
title: "Interactive Analysis Report"
output: html_document
params:
  data: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
if (!is.null(params$data)) df <- params$data
```

## Interactive Scatter

```{r}
if (exists("df")) {
  plot_interactive(df, names(df)[1], names(df)[2])
} else {
  "No data"
}
```

## Time Series

```{r}
if (exists("df")) {
  plot_timeseries(df, names(df)[1], names(df)[2])
} else {
  NULL
}
```
